file_impact.reason: Emitter: reads the labeled candidate JSONL manifest and writes one strict-valid .eval.yaml per balanced criterion into a working tree it atomically replaces; per-side case selection (<=8/criterion, <=4/side, manifest rank order), balance refusal counted skipped-unbalanced, and the emitter report. Flat sibling of fixture_selection.py (the evals/ package has no fixture_mining/ subpackage; a split would create <100-LOC files banned by module policy).
Happy-path oracle: a balanced synthetic manifest emits one file that passes validate_eval_spec(strict=True) with the standard field set.

Held-out oracle: strict-validator over emitted files, balance/gold refusal -> skipped-unbalanced, per-side cap in rank order, stale-file removal across runs, byte-identical idempotence, and network-guard execution.
